"""Read-only, scoped coverage. Unknown lifetime totals never become percentages."""
from sqlalchemy import and_, func, select, text
from db.models import Message
from db.onlyfans_models import OfIngress
from .history_policy import policy, OfOlderHistoryJob
from .store import utcnow


def recent_progress(s, runtime, fan_id=None):
    p = policy(s, runtime.account_id, runtime.binding_id)
    if p is None:
        return None
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import OfRecentHistoryCursor as C, OfRecentHistoryScan
    filters = [C.account_id == runtime.account_id, C.binding_id == runtime.binding_id]
    scope = [Message.account_id == runtime.account_id, Message.created_at >= p.cutoff_at,
        select(OfIngress.event_key).where(OfIngress.account_id == Message.account_id,
            OfIngress.binding_id == runtime.binding_id, OfIngress.fan_id == Message.fan_id,
            OfIngress.message_id == Message.message_id, OfIngress.status == 'applied').exists()]
    if fan_id is not None:
        filters.append(C.fan_id == fan_id)
        scope.append(Message.fan_id == fan_id)
    counts = dict(s.execute(select(C.status, func.count()).where(*filters).group_by(C.status)).all())
    errors = dict(s.execute(select(C.last_error, func.count()).where(*filters,
        C.last_error.is_not(None)).group_by(C.last_error)).all())
    scan = s.get(OfRecentHistoryScan, runtime.account_id)
    discovery = bool(scan and scan.binding_id == runtime.binding_id and scan.status == 'complete'
                     and scan.known_fans_complete and not scan.last_error)
    covered = (bool(counts) if fan_id is not None else discovery) and not (
        counts.get('needed', 0) or counts.get('running', 0) or errors)
    total, fans, incoming = s.execute(select(func.count(), func.count(func.distinct(Message.fan_id)),
        func.count().filter(Message.direction == 'in')).where(*scope)).one()
    params = {'account':runtime.account_id,'binding':runtime.binding_id,'cutoff':p.cutoff_at,'fan':fan_id}
    # Same source-fingerprint receipts as the paid learner, including fact-free results.
    pending = s.scalar(text('''SELECT count(*) FROM messages m WHERE m.account_id=:account
        AND m.created_at>=:cutoff AND m.direction='in' AND (:fan IS NULL OR m.fan_id=:fan)
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_ingress i WHERE i.account_id=m.account_id AND i.binding_id=:binding
            AND i.fan_id=m.fan_id AND i.message_id=m.message_id AND i.status='applied')
        AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM of_profile_receipts r WHERE r.account_id=m.account_id
            AND r.binding_id=:binding AND r.fan_id=m.fan_id AND r.source_fan=m.fan_id
            AND r.message_id=m.message_id AND r.body_md5=md5(m.body) AND r.source_at=m.created_at
            AND r.direction=m.direction AND r.unsent=m.is_unsent AND r.automation=coalesce(m.automation_kind,'')
            AND r.next_chunk=r.total_chunks)'''),params)
    old = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfOlderHistoryJob).where(
        OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id == runtime.account_id, OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id == runtime.binding_id,
        True if fan_id is None else OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id == fan_id))
    from .launch_history_memory.recovery import OfHistoryCursor as L, OfHistoryScan
    lifetime_scan = s.get(OfHistoryScan, runtime.account_id)
    lifetime_states = dict(s.execute(select(L.status,func.count()).where(
        L.account_id==runtime.account_id,L.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,
        True if fan_id is None else L.fan_id==fan_id).group_by(L.status)).all())
    lifetime_complete = bool(lifetime_states) and not (lifetime_states.get('needed',0) or lifetime_states.get('running',0))
    if fan_id is None:
        from db.models import Fan
        missing = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(Fan).where(Fan.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            ~select(L.fan_id).where(L.account_id==Fan.account_id,L.fan_id==Fan.fan_id,L.binding_id==runtime.binding_id).exists()))
        lifetime_complete = bool(lifetime_complete and lifetime_scan and lifetime_scan.status=='complete'
            and lifetime_scan.known_fans_complete and not missing)
    older_done = s.scalar(select(func.count()).select_from(OfOlderHistoryJob).join(L,and_(
        L.account_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id,L.fan_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id,
        L.binding_id==OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id)).where(OfOlderHistoryJob.account_id==runtime.account_id,
        OfOlderHistoryJob.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,L.status=='complete',
        True if fan_id is None else OfOlderHistoryJob.fan_id==fan_id))
    hold = s.execute(text('''SELECT hold_code,hold_until FROM of_profile_accounts
        WHERE account_id=:account AND binding_id=:binding'''),params).first()
    active_hold = bool(hold and hold[1] and str(hold[1]) > str(utcnow()))
    memory_errors = s.scalar(text('''SELECT count(*) FROM of_profile_learning WHERE account_id=:account
        AND binding_id=:binding AND fan_id>0 AND (:fan IS NULL OR fan_id=:fan) AND error_code IS NOT NULL'''),params)
    from .history_telemetry import OfHistoryReadAttempt as A
    attempts, http_attempts, failed, unfinished = s.execute(select(func.count(),
        func.coalesce(func.sum(A.http_attempts),0),func.count().filter(A.outcome=='failed'),
        func.count().filter(A.outcome=='unfinished')).where(A.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            A.binding_id==runtime.binding_id,A.scope=='recent',
            True if fan_id is None else A.fan_id==fan_id)).one()
    from db.models import GrokCall
    from .profile_learning.accounting import metadata
    from decimal import Decimal
    billing = {k:0 for k in ['providerReportedUnits','tokenEstimateUnits','activeReservationUnits','unresolvedReservationUnits']}
    model_ms = 0
    for call in s.scalars(select(GrokCall).where(GrokCall.account_id==runtime.account_id,
            GrokCall.purpose=='gen_info',GrokCall.called_at>=p.started_at,
            True if fan_id is None else GrokCall.fan_id==fan_id)):
        meta = metadata(call)
        bucket = ('activeReservationUnits' if call.status=='pending' else
            'unresolvedReservationUnits' if call.status=='unknown' else
            'providerReportedUnits' if meta.get('billing') in {'provider_reported_cost','provider_reconciled'} else 'tokenEstimateUnits')
        billing[bucket] += call.cost_cents or 0
        model_ms += call.latency_ms or 0
    accounting = {k.replace('Units','Usd'):str(Decimal(v)/10000) for k,v in billing.items()}
    receipt_first, receipt_last = s.execute(text("""SELECT min(processed_at),max(processed_at) FROM of_profile_receipts
        WHERE account_id=:account AND binding_id=:binding AND fan_id>0
        AND source_at>=:cutoff AND processed_at>=:started AND (:fan IS NULL OR fan_id=:fan)"""),{**params,'started':p.started_at}).one()
    accounting.update(scope='account memory calls since fixed policy start, including activated older jobs',
        cumulativeModelCallMilliseconds=model_ms)
    completed_at = s.scalar(select(func.max(C.completed_at)).where(*filters)) if covered else None
    from .history_policy import approved_onboarding
    onboarding = approved_onboarding(s, runtime.account_id, runtime.binding_id)
    return {'creatorOnboarding':{'state':'approved' if onboarding else 'review_required','routineCreatorArchiveExtraction':'disabled'},
        'schemaVersion':'of-recent-history.v1', 'startedAt':p.started_at.isoformat()+'Z',
        'cutoffAt':p.cutoff_at.isoformat()+'Z', 'retentionPolicy':'preserve_all_stored_data',
        'initialHistory':{'state':'recent_history_ready' if covered else 'incomplete',
            'discoveryComplete':discovery,'discoveryPasses':scan.pass_number if scan else 0,
            'discoveryError':scan.last_error if scan else None,
            'conversationsDiscovered':sum(counts.values()),'conversationsReady':counts.get('complete',0),
            'conversationsAwaitingWork':counts.get('needed',0)+counts.get('running',0),
            'messagesSavedInWindow':total,'fansWithStoredWindowMessages':fans,'providerErrors':errors,
            'completedAt':completed_at.isoformat()+'Z' if completed_at else None,
            'elapsedSeconds':max(0,((completed_at or utcnow())-p.started_at).total_seconds()),
            'providerOrdering':'verified_timestamp_desc' if p.timestamp_order_verified else 'id_desc_exhaustive_date_filter',
            'orderingEvidence':p.ordering_evidence,
            'providerRequests':int(http_attempts), 'pageReadAttempts':attempts, 'failedReadAttempts':failed,
            'unfinishedReadAttempts':unfinished, 'providerRequestMeasurement':'HTTP attempts counted at dispatch, including identity probes and failures'},
        'memoryProcessing':{'state':'ready' if covered and pending==0 and not active_hold and not memory_errors else 'incomplete',
            'incomingMessagesInWindow':incoming,'messagesProcessed':incoming-pending,'messagesAwaitingProcessing':pending,
            'firstCurrentRunReceiptAt':str(receipt_first) if receipt_first else None,
            'lastCurrentRunReceiptAt':str(receipt_last) if receipt_last else None,
            'receiptIntervalMeasurement':'wall interval between committed memory receipts; cumulative model latency is separate',
            'errors':memory_errors, 'budgetHold':hold[0] if active_hold else None,
            'completionDoesNotMeanLifetimeHistory':True},
        'memoryModelAccounting':accounting,
        'lifetimeHistory':{'complete':lifetime_complete,'conversationsComplete':lifetime_states.get('complete',0)},
        'olderHistory':{'activatedFanJobs':old,'completedFanJobs':older_done,'pendingFanJobs':old-older_done,'scheduler':'bounded existing archive lane'},
        'lifetimeTotalMessages':None,'percentComplete':None}

def dispatched():

    if active is None:
        return
    store, attempt_id = active
    with Session(store.engine) as s, s.begin():
        row = s.get(OfHistoryReadAttempt, attempt_id, with_for_update=True)
        row.http_attempts += 1


@contextmanager
def measure(store, claim, *, discovery):
    with Session(store.engine) as s:
        enabled = policy(s, claim.account_id, claim.binding_id) is not None
    if not enabled:
        yield
        return
    attempt_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
    with Session(store.engine) as s, s.begin():
        s.add(OfHistoryReadAttempt(id=attempt_id, account_id=claim.account_id, binding_id=claim.binding_id,
            fan_id=None if discovery else claim.fan_id, scope=claim.scope,
            operation='discovery' if discovery else 'messages', started_at=utcnow()))
    token = _ACTIVE.set((store, attempt_id))
    outcome = 'succeeded'
    try:
        yield
    except BaseException:
        outcome = 'failed'
        raise
    finally:
        _ACTIVE.reset(token)
        with Session(store.engine) as s, s.begin():
            row = s.get(OfHistoryReadAttempt, attempt_id)
            row.finished_at, row.outcome = utcnow(), outcome

def _since_rank(item, *, fallback=0):
    since = item.info.get("onlyfans_since")
    if since is None:
        return fallback
    if since not in REVISION_RANK:
        raise SchemaMismatch(f"Unknown metadata revision {since}")
    return REVISION_RANK[since]


def _table_rank(table):
    if table.info.get("onlyfans_foundation"):
        fallback = REVISION_RANK[FOUNDATION]
    elif table.name in {"of_creator_bindings", "of_conversation_state", "of_message_delivery"}:
        fallback = REVISION_RANK[BASELINE]
    else:
        fallback = 0
    return _since_rank(table, fallback=fallback)


def revision(conn: Connection) -> str | None:
    if not inspect(conn).has_table("alembic_version"):
        return None
    versions = conn.execute(text("SELECT version_num FROM alembic_version")).scalars().all()
    if len(versions) != 1:
        raise SchemaMismatch("Expected one schema revision")
    return versions[0]


def check_schema(conn: Connection, *, expected: str = HEAD) -> None:
    """No DDL, repair, stamping or implicit compatibility fallback."""
    if conn.dialect.name != "postgresql":
        raise SchemaMismatch("OnlyFans runtime requires PostgreSQL")
    # Outside the dump's public schema: committed BEFORE pg_restore can write
    # any old authority records. A crash cannot leave a restored sender ready.
    if "onlyfans_restore" in inspect(conn).get_schema_names():
        raise SchemaMismatch("Restored database is quarantined pending authoritative reconciliation")
    if expected not in REVISION_RANK:
        raise SchemaMismatch("Unsupported expected schema revision")
    if revision(conn) != expected:
        raise SchemaMismatch("Database revision is not supported by this process")
    inspector = inspect(conn)
    tables = set(inspector.get_table_names())
    failures = []
    expected_rank = REVISION_RANK[expected]
    # These two valid release lines use overlapping numeric prefixes.
    # Membership must follow Alembic ancestry, not just numeric rank.
    from alembic.script import ScriptDirectory
    ancestors = {r.revision for r in ScriptDirectory.from_config(_config(conn)).iterate_revisions(expected, "base")}
    def since_rank(item, *, fallback=0):
        since = item.info.get("onlyfans_since")
        return 10**9 if since and since not in ancestors else _since_rank(item, fallback=fallback)
    def table_rank(table):
        since = table.info.get("onlyfans_since")
        return 10**9 if since and since not in ancestors else _table_rank(table)
    for table in _metadata().sorted_tables:
        if table_rank(table) > expected_rank:
            continue
        if table.name not in tables:
            failures.append(f"missing table {table.name}")
            continue
        actual = {c["name"]: c for c in inspector.get_columns(table.name)}
        for column in table.columns:
            if since_rank(column) > expected_rank:
                continue
            other = actual.get(column.name)
            if other is None or other["type"]._type_affinity != column.type._type_affinity:
                failures.append(f"incompatible column {table.name}.{column.name}")
            elif not column.nullable and other["nullable"]:
                failures.append(f"nullable required column {table.name}.{column.name}")
        pk = inspector.get_pk_constraint(table.name)["constrained_columns"]
        if pk != [c.name for c in table.primary_key]:
            failures.append(f"incompatible key {table.name}")
        indexes = {i["name"]: i for i in inspector.get_indexes(table.name)}
        for index in table.indexes:
            if since_rank(index) > expected_rank or any(since_rank(c) > expected_rank for c in index.columns):
                continue
            other = indexes.get(index.name)
            if other is None or other["unique"] != bool(index.unique) or other["column_names"] != [c.name for c in index.columns]:
                failures.append(f"incompatible index {index.name}")
            elif index.dialect_options["postgresql"].get("where") is not None:
                # A full unique constraint is NOT an equivalent active-binding index.

                    failures.append(f"incompatible predicate {index.name}")
        actual_fks = {(tuple(f["constrained_columns"]), f["referred_table"], tuple(f["referred_columns"])) for f in inspector.get_foreign_keys(table.name)}
        for fk in table.foreign_key_constraints:
            if any(since_rank(c) > expected_rank for c in fk.columns):
                continue
            signature = (tuple(c.name for c in fk.columns), fk.referred_table.name, tuple(e.column.name for e in fk.elements))
            if signature not in actual_fks:
                failures.append(f"missing foreign key {table.name}")
        actual_uniques = {tuple(c["column_names"]) for c in inspector.get_unique_constraints(table.name)}
        for constraint in table.constraints:
            if constraint.__class__.__name__ == "UniqueConstraint" and since_rank(constraint) <= expected_rank and all(since_rank(c) <= expected_rank for c in constraint.columns):

                    failures.append(f"missing unique constraint {table.name}")
        if table.name == "of_content_sync_conflict" and 89 <= expected_rank < 91:
            if ("account_id", "item_id", "observation_id") not in actual_uniques:
                failures.append("missing historical unique constraint of_content_sync_conflict")
        expected_checks = {c.name for c in table.constraints if c.__class__.__name__ == "CheckConstraint" and c.name and since_rank(c) <= expected_rank}
        actual_checks = {c["name"] for c in inspector.get_check_constraints(table.name)}
        if not expected_checks.issubset(actual_checks):
            failures.append(f"missing check constraint {table.name}")

def _config(conn: Connection) -> Config:
    cfg = Config(str(HERE / "migrations/alembic.ini"))
    cfg.attributes["connection"] = conn
    return cfg


def bootstrap(conn: Connection) -> None:
    """Caller owns transaction; never stamp or overlay any existing schema."""
    if conn.dialect.name != "postgresql":
        raise SchemaMismatch("Bootstrap requires PostgreSQL")
    conn.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7811070)"))
    if inspect(conn).get_table_names() or inspect(conn).get_view_names():
        raise SchemaMismatch("Bootstrap requires an empty database schema")
    conn.exec_driver_sql((HERE / "snapshots/0070_postgresql.sql").read_text())
    command.stamp(_config(conn), BASELINE)
    check_schema(conn, expected=BASELINE)
    command.upgrade(_config(conn), HEAD)
    check_schema(conn)


def upgrade(conn: Connection) -> None:
    if conn.dialect.name != "postgresql":
        raise SchemaMismatch("Upgrade requires PostgreSQL")
    conn.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(7811070)"))
    current = revision(conn)
    if current not in REVISION_RANK:
        raise SchemaMismatch("Unsupported legacy schema; rehearse a validated import first")
    check_schema(conn, expected=current)
    command.upgrade(_config(conn), HEAD)
    check_schema(conn)


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("action", choices=("bootstrap", "upgrade", "check"))
    parser.add_argument("--url-env", default="ONLYFANS_MIGRATION_URL", help="Environment variable containing the explicit target URL")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    import os
    raw = os.environ.get(args.url_env)
    if not raw or make_url(raw).get_backend_name() != "postgresql":
        parser.error("An explicit PostgreSQL target is required")
    url = make_url(raw).set(drivername="postgresql+psycopg2")
    engine = create_engine(url, pool_size=1, max_overflow=0, connect_args={"options": "-c timezone=UTC -c lock_timeout=5000 -c statement_timeout=30000"})
    try:
        with engine.begin() as conn:
            {"bootstrap": bootstrap, "upgrade": upgrade, "check": check_schema}[args.action](conn)
        print(f"OnlyFans schema {args.action}: ready ({HEAD})")
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
